en: Color image of a lakeside leisure area with pedal boats and rowboats on calm blue water, a sandy beach crowded with sunbathers and swimmers, and willow trees lining the shore. Flower boxes filled with colorful blossoms sit on a metal fence in the foreground, with spherical lampposts on either side. In the background rise steep, rocky mountains under a bright blue sky with scattered clouds. The style suggests a mid‑20th‑century tourist resort in an Alpine region.
